443-4279-6273--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-6273--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-4454-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4454-6797.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-4247-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4247-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

856-3263-3899-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-728-5470-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-6566--5--195.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature has any type of counter on it.
728-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a persist creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

851-1308-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
2438-6972-7804.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

573-1558-2097-3875-4231.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Jolene.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-7356.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

2525-3358-7175.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-5003-6418.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mausoleum Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Mausoleum Guard dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Mausoleum Guard trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mausoleum Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1987-2239-4276-6991.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2239-4276-6991.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Donnie & April.
When Ardent Elementalist and Donnie & April enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-4276-6991.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

997-2866-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

654-3293-4693-5721.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
654-3293-4693-5721.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd and Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping each land that entered.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
654-3293-4693-5721.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1274-4186-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-4476.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3698-5727-6705.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station and The Prydwen triggers.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-5627-6662.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-5627-6662.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2281-3175-5231.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sun Titan, adding {R}.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4824-5963-6478.description:
Activate Marvin using Arbor Adherent's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1308-5742-5743.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2793-3017-3129-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3017-3129-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

64-5352.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
64-5352.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Warden of the Eye and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Warden of the Eye tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other noncreature, nonland cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

2527-4073-4076-4549-5633.notablePrerequisites: Burakos does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-4073-4076-4549-5633.description:
Cast Fleshbag Marauder by paying {2}{B}.
When Fleshbag Marauder enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding {B}.
Burakos triggers, giving it and all creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Fleshbag Marauder trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice Burakos, and each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Burakos, giving Fleshbag Marauder -1/-1 until end of turn.
Fleshbag Marauder dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 one additional time.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Burakos and Fleshbag Marauder, giving Fleshbag Marauder -2/-2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 8.

167-864-4050.description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {B}.
When Eternal Witness dies, it and any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it trigger.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1170-3664-3803-4074-5261.notablePrerequisites: You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
1170-3664-3803-4074-5261.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream's Grip without paying its mana cost, targeting Isochron Scepter.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Dream's Grip, targeting Lotus Field.
Resolve both Dream's Grips, untapping Isochron Scepter and Lotus Field.
Repeat.

3750-3920-4050.notablePrerequisites: Valduk has at least five Auras and/or Equipments attached to it.
3750-3920-4050.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Valduk triggers, creating at least five 3/1 Elemental creature tokens with trample and haste.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Elementals, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If Valduk has at least six Auras and/or Equipments attached to it, this combo nets infinite Elemental tokens and colored mana.

1496-2034-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1} and either {W} or two life.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher, causing it to enter the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain three life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3492-3609-4034.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper and Yore-Tiller Nephilim do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Yore-Tiller Nephilim or Coretapper.
3492-3609-4034.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat each turn.

2060-2854-3062-4770.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-3062-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{W}.
Whitemane Lion triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
